rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; project retained. The qualified business loss carryforward to next year is zero within scope because lines 2 and 3 are zero (no business income or carryforward is supported); the second transcription computes the smaller of their combination and zero as printed.

Ruling: scope; project retained. The REIT/PTP loss carryforward is zero within scope because line 7 (prior-year REIT/PTP loss carryforward) is refused by `qbi.unsupported`; the second transcription computes it as printed.

Ruling: scope; project retained. Lines 2 through 5 of Form 8995 carry qualified business income from trades or businesses and the prior-year loss carryforward, which are outside scope: the only qualified business income supported is section 199A dividends (spec 2.1), and `qbi.unsupported` refuses anything else. Within scope the line is zero, as the project pins it; the second transcription computes it as printed.
Ruling: scope; project retained. As for line 4: 20% of a line 4 that is zero within scope.

Ruling: equivalent within scope; project retained. The printed line combines lines 6 and 7 and floors at zero; line 7 is zero within scope (refused carryforward), so the project's copy of line 6 is the same value. The second transcription encodes the combination as printed, which is the form's text; if line 7 ever carries a value the project's line 8 must change, and this ruling records that.
